body.name: Critical repeated-star construction
body.construction: For fixed \(\beta>0\), take \(k_n=\lfloor\beta n^{2/3}\rfloor\), \(m_n=\lfloor n/(k_n+1)\rfloor\) disjoint stars with \(k_n\) leaves, and isolated padding vertices; put \(a_{n,i}=1,b_{n,i}=0\) on leaves and \(a_{n,i}=b_{n,i}=0\) elsewhere.
